newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to say U.S. budget deficit is $37 billion.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to say U.S. budget deficit is $37 billion.

text.p: President Clinton will announce Wednesday that the revised U.S. budget deficit for the current fiscal year has fallen to $37 billion, a senior White House official said.
"The revised figure will be $37 billion," the official said, discussing the announcement Clinton is to make at his 2 p.m. EDT (1800 GMT) news conference.

The official said the final administration estimate for the fiscal year, which ends Sept. 30, was made during Wednesday morning. Earlier in the day, the estimate had been put at slightly more than $36 billion.
The final estimate is dramatically below last year's deficit figure of $107 billion.
The new estimate came a day after Clinton signed legislation intended to balance the federal budget by 2002 while at the same time giving Americans a big tax cut.
The United States has not posted a budget surplus since 1969.
